Wednesday Night Trail Party (Northshore)

Flower Mound, TX · Northshore Trail, Lake Grapevine · Mountain bike

Wednesday Night Trail Party (Northshore) is a mountain bike group ride in Flower Mound, TX. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from MADD shelter, Northshore Trail.

For visitors

Mountain bike ride on the trail. Bring lights once it gets dark. DORBA's page gives no pace or level.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Night Trail Party (Northshore) group ride

A weekly mountain bike ride on Northshore, the big trail system on Lake Grapevine, listed on DORBA's weekly rides page. Starts at the MADD shelter at 6:30 pm on Wednesdays. The page gives no pace or level, so ask in the DORBA community first.
